description:
Poll a checkout session until it's paid or ends, up to timeout_seconds. Reports progress while it waits.

If the buyer hasn't finished when the timeout hits, this returns status 'open' (not an error) — call it again to keep waiting. Sessions expire 30 minutes after creation.

Args:
  - session_id: from jami_create_checkout.
  - timeout_seconds: 5–300 (default 90).
  - interval_seconds: 2–30 between polls (default 3).

Returns the same shape as jami_get_checkout_status.

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for a readable summary, 'json' for the full structured payload

session_id.description: Checkout session id returned by jami_create_checkout, e.g. "6710c2e8b1a2f0012ab34cd9"

name: jami_wait_for_checkout

failure.description: Why the session ended without an order; null unless status is "expired"

title: Wait for checkout
